run_viz_dataset_cli: run the viz_dataset CLI with --data citibike to plot coordinates and KDE for a dataset
plot_coordinates_scatter: create a scatter plot of spatial coordinates on a map and save as a PNG image
plot_kde_density: create a kernel density estimate contour plot of spatial coordinates with optional text overlay
plot_density_loglik: create a density contour plot from a log-likelihood function evaluated on a spatial grid
load_data_factory: load a named spatiotemporal dataset like citibike or earthquakes by name and split
